title: The AI tool that writes entire apps in seconds

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if an AI could write a full app in seconds—what does that mean for developers, users, and society?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current tools like GitHub Copilot and Code Llama can generate code, but full apps require integration, testing, and user interface design.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Rapid app generation risks job displacement and could lead to a flood of low-quality, insecure software with little oversight.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on AI-assisted development, not replacement—emphasizing security, collaboration, and human oversight.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In five years, AI might co-create apps with humans, democratizing tech and enabling faster, more inclusive innovation.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will balance AI's speed with human values, shaping a world where technology serves people, not the other way around.

video_cue: A developer using an AI interface to rapidly build and test a mobile app in a sleek, futuristic workspace.
